name: ClickHouse Loom
summary: Self-hosted MCP server for shared agent memory, source-linked coding lessons, and document search with citations.
description: Coding agents can share decisions and corrections across sessions through namespaces with scoped access. A saved lesson can link to a definition in an indexed repository, so a later agent can retrieve the lesson with the code and check whether the definition has changed.

agent_access.notes: MCP clients connect to the /mcp path on their own Loom deployment. The setup guide covers scoped credentials and supported clients.
